title: 0071: second-step feedback correction (fbn)
intro: Clip 0071 was not used for tuning. The right side adds the gain-corrected render-feedback correction inside the gyro-noise bursts only; outside the bursts both sides should look the same.

items.name: Throttle-pin burst
items.look: Main test: the long full-throttle burst. The first-pass correction overshot here; judder should now be clearly lower on the right.

items.name: Late event
items.look: Wobble should be lower on the right; watch for any added fine shake.

items.name: Clean control
items.look: No correction is applied here: both sides should look identical.
